steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for DTLS 1.3 · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
合法亂序被丟棄可能是視窗太小，或epoch狀態混用；擴大視窗不能修復跨epoch錯誤。
對照「DTLS 1.3 · 信任契約與反例資料」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。依本地亂序需求評估記憶體成本與寬度，保留重複拒絕及認證後更新；不將較大視窗描述成較強密碼保護。
本階段必須重驗：為本課建立 fixture.csv：每列記錄識別碼、完整輸入、信任來源、預期判定及理由；正常與異常資料都保留。未提供的屬性保持缺值，不可悄悄補成允許值。先寫預期結果，再進行測試，並區分協定要求與自行選定的教學門檻。
steps.instructionEn:
A legitimate reordered record may be dropped because the window is too small or because state from different epochs was mixed. Increasing window width cannot repair incorrect epoch separation.
Against the nominal DTLS 1.3 · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Choose width against a local reordering requirement and memory budget while retaining duplicate rejection and authenticated updates. A larger window improves tolerance in this model; it does not strengthen the cryptographic algorithm.
Reverify this criterion: Create fixture.csv for this case with row ID, complete inputs, trust source, expected decision and reason. Retain valid and invalid rows. Keep absent attributes absent instead of silently replacing them with permissive values. Write expected outcomes before evaluating the fixtures, and distinguish protocol requirements from thresholds selected only for this exercise.

steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. A legitimate reordered record may be dropped because the window is too small or because state from different epochs was mixed. Increasing window width cannot repair incorrect epoch separation.

steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: DTLS保留資料報特性，不能直接沿用TLS可靠串流的直覺；本課實作本地教學滑動視窗，明確區分協定能力與自行採用的反重播政策。
knowledge.textEn: DTLS preserves datagram behavior rather than reliable-stream assumptions. Implement a local teaching sliding window and explicitly distinguish this chosen anti-replay policy from a claim that DTLS guarantees reliable delivery or universal replay protection.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 以epoch、序號及已見位元建立接收狀態；準備新紀錄、視窗內未見亂序、已見重複與太舊紀錄四類，所有封包僅為離線整數描述。
knowledge.textEn: Model receiver state with epoch, sequence number and seen bits. Prepare fresh records, unseen in-window reordering, seen duplicates and too-old records, represented solely as offline integers rather than captured or injected network traffic.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 本課寬度W的含端點視窗為[H−W+1,H]；已見重複拒絕，未見且在窗內可接受。驗證標記只能在記錄認證成功後更新。
knowledge.textEn: The selected inclusive window is [H−W+1,H] for width W and highest authenticated sequence H. Reject seen duplicates and allow unseen in-window records. Update seen state only after record authentication succeeds, preventing unauthenticated metadata from advancing the model.

steps.title: DTLS 1.3 · 信任契約與反例資料 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: DTLS 1.3 · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「DTLS 1.3 · 信任契約與反例資料」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for DTLS 1.3 · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付dtls-window.csv、位元圖狀態機與跨epoch負例；不傳送任何網路資料報。
在交接件中加入「DTLS 1.3 · 信任契約與反例資料」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：為本課建立 fixture.csv：每列記錄識別碼、完整輸入、信任來源、預期判定及理由；正常與異常資料都保留。未提供的屬性保持缺值，不可悄悄補成允許值。先寫預期結果，再進行測試，並區分協定要求與自行選定的教學門檻。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：以epoch、序號及已見位元建立接收狀態；準備新紀錄、視窗內未見亂序、已見重複與太舊紀錄四類，所有封包僅為離線整數描述。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver dtls-window.csv, the bitmap state machine and cross-epoch counterexamples. The experiment sends no datagrams and requires no external endpoint.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for DTLS 1.3 · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures: Create fixture.csv for this case with row ID, complete inputs, trust source, expected decision and reason. Retain valid and invalid rows. Keep absent attributes absent instead of silently replacing them with permissive values. Write expected outcomes before evaluating the fixtures, and distinguish protocol requirements from thresholds selected only for this exercise.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Model receiver state with epoch, sequence number and seen bits. Prepare fresh records, unseen in-window reordering, seen duplicates and too-old records, represented solely as offline integers rather than captured or injected network traffic. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。為本課建立 fixture.csv：每列記錄識別碼、完整輸入、信任來源、預期判定及理由；正常與異常資料都保留。未提供的屬性保持缺值，不可悄悄補成允許值。先寫預期結果，再進行測試，並區分協定要求與自行選定的教學門檻。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Create fixture.csv for this case with row ID, complete inputs, trust source, expected decision and reason. Retain valid and invalid rows. Keep absent attributes absent instead of silently replacing them with permissive values. Write expected outcomes before evaluating the fixtures, and distinguish protocol requirements from thresholds selected only for this exercise.

steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
